title: Premium Months Returned on a Stopped HECM Draw Check
content:
Cedarline returns the mortgage insurance premium on a stopped Home Equity Conversion Mortgage (HECM) draw check only for the months it can still correct with FHA. The premium months are set as follows, the first matching line applying:

1. when the accrual months charged exceed 6, the premium months are 6;
2. when a mortgage insurance premium accrual posted on the loan is dated after the stopped check's effective date, the premium months are the accrual months charged;
3. otherwise the premium months are 0.

The accrual months charged are the calendar months from the month of the stopped check's effective date to the month of the most recent interest accrual dated after it.

| Accrual months charged | Premium accrual dated after the check's effective date | Premium months |
|---|---|---|
| 9 | yes or no | 6 |
| 7 | yes or no | 6 |
| 6 | yes | 6 |
| 6 | no | 0 |
| 3 | yes | 3 |
| 3 | no | 0 |

The line at 6 is not crossed by 6 itself: 6 accrual months do not exceed 6, so the second or third line decides.
